lines.text: Director Vantongeren identifies the template as her original. Your record gives the stamp and the warm canister. Her identification needs its own verification.
Your record has Okafor back from the nave. She says the visit is about the dreams. That is her account; Sablier does not get to fill in the silence.
The index gives no earlier template. I can tell you what it records. I cannot sign a lineage it does not have.
The register has four arrivals. The clinic promises care. A promise from Sablier has a department behind it; keep the entry if you need to call us on it.
The clinic offers care. The alternatives are on the record. Read them before you promise anyone a destination.
Sablier made you. Sablier can make you better. Card's on the desk.
Sablier made you. That doesn't mean a card chooses your work. Read it yourself.
